using CUDA
CUDA.allowscalar(false)
module Ref
# pv_a10(x, y, tot, n)
#
# The accumulated scalar is read in the condition of a `while` that runs in each thread.
#
# x: input of length n
# y: output of length n
# tot: length-1 output
# n: number of points
function pv_a10(x, y, tot, n)
    acc = 0.0
    for i = 1:n
        y[i] = x[i] * x[i]
        acc += y[i]
    end
    for i = 1:n
        r = y[i]
        while r > 0.001 * abs(acc)
            r = 0.5 * r
        end
        y[i] = r
    end
    tot[1] = acc
    return nothing
end

end
module MC
using CUDA, LinearAlgebra

@inline function __stade_wa_xor(m::UInt32, u::UInt64, k::Int32)
        lo = shfl_xor_sync(m, UInt32(u & 0x00000000ffffffff), k)
        hi = shfl_xor_sync(m, UInt32(u >> 32), k)
        return UInt64(hi) << 32 | UInt64(lo)
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_lane1(m::UInt32, u::UInt64)
        lo = shfl_sync(m, UInt32(u & 0x00000000ffffffff), Int32(1))
        hi = shfl_sync(m, UInt32(u >> 32), Int32(1))
        return UInt64(hi) << 32 | UInt64(lo)
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_add!(arr, idx::Integer, val::Float64)
        m = active_mask()
        if m == 0xffffffff
            i = Int64(idx)
            if vote_all_sync(m, i == reinterpret(Int64, __stade_wa_lane1(m, reinterpret(UInt64, i))))
                v = val
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(16)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(8)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(4)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(2)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(1)))
                if ((threadIdx()).x - 1) & 31 == 0
                    CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += v
                end
                return nothing
            end
        end
        CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += val
        return nothing
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_add!(arr, idx::Integer, val::Float32)
        m = active_mask()
        if m == 0xffffffff
            i = Int64(idx)
            if vote_all_sync(m, i == reinterpret(Int64, __stade_wa_lane1(m, reinterpret(UInt64, i))))
                v = val
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(16))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(8))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(4))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(2))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(1))
                if ((threadIdx()).x - 1) & 31 == 0
                    CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += v
                end
                return nothing
            end
        end
        CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += val
        return nothing
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_add!(arr, idx, val)
        CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += val
        return nothing
    end

function cuda_kernel_pv_a10_1!(acc, n, x, y)
    @inbounds begin
            __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
            if __tid > div(n - 1, 1) + 1
                return nothing
            end
            i = 1 + (__tid - 1)
            y[i] = x[i] * x[i]
            __stade_wa_add!(acc, 1, y[i])
            return nothing
        end
end

function cuda_kernel_pv_a10_2!(acc, n, y)
    @inbounds begin
            __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
            if __tid > div(n - 1, 1) + 1
                return nothing
            end
            i = 1 + (__tid - 1)
            r = y[i]
            while r > 0.001 * abs(acc[1])
                r = 0.5r
            end
            y[i] = r
            return nothing
        end
end

function pv_a10_cuda(x, y, tot, n)
    acc = CuArray([0.0])
    nthread_per_block = 256
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            acc[1] = 0.0
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_pv_a10_1!(acc, n, x, y)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_pv_a10_2!(acc, n, y)
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            tot[1] = acc[1]
        end
    return nothing
end

end

import JACC
using JSON3
res = Dict{String,Any}()
res["device"] = string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))
for n in (100, 1000, 5000)
    x = [10.0^(2.0 * sin(0.7 * i + 0.1 * i * i)) for i in 1:n]
    y0 = zeros(n); t0 = zeros(1); Ref.pv_a10(x, y0, t0, n)
    for (nm, run) in (("cuda", () -> begin y = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); t = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1); MC.pv_a10_cuda(CuArray(x), y, t, n); (Array(y), Array(t)) end),
                      ("jacc", () -> begin y = JACC.array(zeros(n)); t = JACC.array(zeros(1)); MJ.pv_a10_jacc(JACC.array(x), y, t, n); (Array(y), Array(t)) end))
        d = Dict{String,Any}()
        try
            (y, t) = run(); CUDA.synchronize()
            d["y_max_abs_diff"] = maximum(abs.(y .- y0)); d["acc_cpu"] = t0[1]; d["acc_dev"] = t[1]
            d["acc_rel_err"] = abs(t[1] - t0[1]) / abs(t0[1])
            d["changed"] = count(y .!= x .* x)
            d["ok"] = d["y_max_abs_diff"] <= 1e-12 * maximum(abs.(y0)) && d["acc_rel_err"] < 1e-10 && d["changed"] > 0
        catch e
            d["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 600); d["ok"] = false
        end
        res["$(nm)_$(n)"] = d
    end
end
println(JSON3.write(res))
